overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets the break/subtotal cell at colNum/breakNum to display the result of one or more accumulated operators (sum, average, count, min, max, standard deviation) instead of literal text.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the cell should display a computed aggregate rather than literal/templated text.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets the break/subtotal cell at colNum/breakNum to a literal text template, which may embed placeholders (#, ##S, ##A, ##C, ##X, ##N, ##D, ##<colNum>) that are substituted with the break value or computed aggregates.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the cell should display literal/templated text rather than a raw computed aggregate.

constraints: operator and value are mutually exclusive: a single call sets either an operator (aggregate) or a text template for the cell, never both.
operator is an additive combination of the QR Operators theme constants (qr sum=1, qr average=2, qr count=16, qr max=8, qr min=4, qr standard deviation=32); 0 means no operator.
For the grand total, breakNum is -3 (qr grand total); for a subtotal, breakNum is the sort/break number.
This command cannot create a new subtotal, only set the details of an existing break.
